caption:
Anime for beginners: the version of your favorite game you have not watched yet.

Elden Ring fans start with Berserk, the manga widely credited as one of the game's biggest influences. God of War fans get Vinland Saga. The Last of Us fans go straight to Made in Abyss. Bonus for Dark Souls fans: Dorohedoro.

Which game should we convert next?

Tag the friend who needs this.
